description: Get Twitch users, optionally filtered by login names and/or user ids.

logins.description: Optional list of login names to filter users by (case-insensitive).

ids.description: Optional list of user ids to filter users by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of user objects (id, login, display_name, view_count, etc.); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get live streams, optionally filtered by user logins, user ids, and/or game id. Results are sorted by viewer_count descending.

user_logins.description: Optional list of user login names to filter live streams by.

user_ids.description: Optional list of user ids to filter live streams by.

game_id.description: Optional game id to filter live streams by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of live stream objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get channel information for one or more broadcaster ids.

broadcaster_ids.description: List of broadcaster ids whose channel information should be returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of channel objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the follower total for a channel identified by its broadcaster id.

broadcaster_id.description: The broadcaster id of the channel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a data list and a total follower count; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the top games ranked by popularity.

first.description: Maximum number of top games to return (default 20).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of game objects ordered by rank; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get games, optionally filtered by name and/or id.

names.description: Optional list of game names to filter by (case-insensitive).

ids.description: Optional list of game ids to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of game objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get clips, optionally filtered by broadcaster id and/or game id. Results are sorted by view_count descending.

broadcaster_id.description: Optional broadcaster id to filter clips by.

game_id.description: Optional game id to filter clips by.

first.description: Maximum number of clips to return (default 20).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of clip objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
